references.observed: Actually inspected full forecourt and main facade: mint blue/cream palace, two-story main range with small lower windows and tall upper arched windows, raised central baroque crown and paired projecting tall risalits, shallow gray-blue hipped roof, chimneys and white open parapets. Attached one-story side ranges turn into extended end annexes; actual U forecourt and both fountains stay open.

Actually inspected wider main forecourt: U-shaped low wings with higher long central palace, three projecting high facade crowns, open roof balustrades, separate fenced entry and two garden/fountain beds. Similar front viewpoint to first photo; it confirms the full spread of wings, not a distinct rear view.

Actually inspected oblique right/east low wing and main facade: returned hipped gray-blue roofs, repeated dormer/cross-roof rhythm, white chimneys/open parapets, deep framed windows and original simplified blue/cream trim. Long transverse end annex and inner service court/glazed portion are visible. The main facade has actual depth and tall forward risalits. Event furniture, flags, insignia, figures and gardens are not copied.
